Monitor: /monitors command (armed panel id/name/excerpt/age/time-left, cancel <id> via gate-skipping internals, headless silent no-op, completions) and the poll guard now counts the delegations results action (list|log|results). Subagent: in-memory result cache (ring of last 8, dual-indexed by delegation_id and parent_id, eviction/duplicate/parent-omission hygiene, injected-clock timestamps, char caps 120/2000/6000 with head/tail markers) wired at the deliverNote entry before the 2s batch window; structured results ride every card (details.result single, details.notes[i].result batched); delegations results [id] action with registry-disambiguated misses. Versions subagent 1.2.0, monitor 1.1.0. High-effort: plan-review MoE (2 experts, READY-WITH-FOLDS, 9 musts folded), two disjoint lanes (A subagent / B monitor) merged clean, implementation MoE (3 experts, triple SHIP, zero musts), QA review-tests GATE: BLOCKED cleared (mutation-proven aborted-note wiring row + rejection-redirect pins). 771 tests green (765 pass, 6 gated skips), typecheck clean.
